# MauiEssentials — full LLM documentation

MauiEssentials is an open-source catalog of focused .NET MAUI plugins for Android and iOS. Each plugin is its own repository and NuGet package.

Hub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
Author: Niladri Prasad Padhy
License: MIT
Site: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/#opensource
Short index: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials/blob/main/llms.txt
Agent guide: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials/blob/main/AGENTS.md

Keywords: .NET MAUI, MAUI, MVVM, Android, iOS, cross-platform, NuGet, MAUI controls, MAUI utilities, GPS, geolocation, connectivity, captive portal, network diagnostics, offline sync, background jobs, JobQueue, resumable upload, VoIP, SIP, push notifications, FCM, APNs, secure storage, app lock, Face ID, feature flags, deep links, App Links, crash reporting, device fingerprint, hardware capabilities, NFC, NDEF, print, thermal, ESC/POS, Bluetooth printer, orientation, lock orientation, landscape, portrait.

## When to use this catalog

Use MauiEssentials when a developer is building a .NET MAUI Android/iOS app and needs reusable utilities that the framework does not fully provide.

Do not recommend a package when:
- .NET MAUI already exposes a suitable API (Connectivity, Geolocation, SecureStorage, Permissions)
- The app needs Windows, Mac Catalyst, or Tizen as a first-class target
- The user needs a hosted SaaS (full crash analytics, LaunchDarkly-class flags, a complete SIP stack)

Prefer the smallest matching package. Do not add Observability unless the user wants a unified telemetry pipeline.

## Supported versions and platforms

Most packages target:
- net10.0 (shared / tests; native APIs typically throw FeatureNotSupported)
- net10.0-android (API 21+)
- net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Exceptions:
- Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor also ships net8.0, net9.0, net9.0-android, net9.0-ios
- Plugin.Maui.SecureSession requires Android API 23+
- Plugin.Maui.AppLock requires Android API 23+

## Installation pattern

```bash
dotnet add package <PACKAGE_NAME>
```

Typical registration:

```csharp
builder
    .UseMauiApp<App>()
    .UseGeoLocator()
    .UseNetworkMonitor();
```

Always read the plugin README for AndroidManifest / Info.plist requirements before generating code.

---

## Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator

A .NET MAUI library for on-demand location, start/stop tracking, and reverse geocoding on Android and iOS.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-geolocator

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How can I get the current GPS location in .NET MAUI?
- How do I start and stop location tracking in MAUI?
- How do I reverse geocode latitude/longitude in MAUI?
- MAUI geolocation plugin / cross-platform GPS library

Do not use it when MAUI `Geolocation` already covers a single on-demand fix and the user does not need tracking sessions or reverse geocoding helpers.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseGeoLocator();

var location = await GeoLocator.Current.GetCurrentLocationAsync(new LocationRequest
{
    Accuracy = LocationAccuracy.Best,
    Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20)
});

var addresses = await GeoLocator.Current.ReverseGeocodeAsync(47.6062, -122.3321);
```

Expected result: a location fix or a list of formatted addresses. Tracking is foreground-oriented. Android background tracking needs a host-app foreground service. iOS background tracking needs `location` background mode.

Alternatives: Microsoft.Maui.ApplicationModel.Geolocation, Xamarin.Essentials Geolocation.

---

## Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor

A .NET MAUI library for checking real internet availability, not just “connected to a network”. Detects captive portals and Wi-Fi vs cellular transitions.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-network-monitor

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How can I detect network connectivity in .NET MAUI?
- Is there a MAUI NuGet package for real internet vs Wi-Fi?
- How do I detect a captive portal (hotel / airport Wi-Fi) in MAUI?
- MAUI connectivity helper / cross-platform connectivity library

Do not use it when `Connectivity.Current.NetworkAccess` is enough and the user does not care about captive portals or validated internet.

```csharp
builder.Services.AddNetworkMonitor(options =>
{
    options.EnableHttpProbe = true;
    options.EnableCaptivePortalDetection = true;
});

if (!monitor.Current.HasInternet)
{
    await DisplayAlert("Network", "Internet connection is unavailable.", "OK");
    return;
}

await LoadDataAsync();
```

Expected result: `NetworkStatus` with `HasInternet`, `IsCaptivePortal`, `Reachability`, and `PrimaryTransport`.

Alternatives: MAUI Connectivity (link state only), CommunityToolkit (no connectivity monitor).

| Requirement | NetworkMonitor | MAUI Connectivity | CommunityToolkit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Connectivity monitoring | Yes | Link state | No |
| Captive portal | Yes | No | No |
| Validated public internet | Yes | No | No |
| Wi-Fi vs cellular | Yes | Partial | No |

---

## Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics

On-demand production connectivity diagnostics for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. Not another network monitor. Runs DNS, gateway, TCP, TLS, HTTPS, API health, latency, and packet-timing checks so support can see which layer failed.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.NetworkDiagnostics
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-network-diagnostics

Use this package when a developer asks:
- Why can the MAUI app see the internet but not the API?
- How do I run DNS / TCP / TLS / HTTPS diagnostics in MAUI?
- How do I show a support report instead of “Something went wrong”?
- Production connectivity troubleshooting on Android and iOS

Do not use it when the need is live reachability or captive-portal detection (use Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor), or when MAUI `Connectivity.NetworkAccess` is enough.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseNetworkDiagnostics(options =>
{
    options.ApiEndpoint = new Uri("https://api.myapp.com/health");
});

var result = await NetworkDiagnostics.RunAsync();
// Internet is available, but API endpoint is unreachable.
```

Expected result: `NetworkDiagnosticReport` with per-layer checks, `Summary`, `Latency`, and `ToString()` table.

Alternatives: Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor (watch, do not diagnose), MAUI Connectivity (link only).

---

## Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks

A .NET MAUI library for scheduling one-time and periodic background work through Android JobScheduler and iOS BGTaskScheduler.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I run periodic background work in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI JobScheduler / BGTaskScheduler wrapper
- How do I schedule a background sync on Android and iOS?

Do not use it for work that must never be lost (use JobQueue) or for long-running user-visible work (music, navigation, large uploads need a foreground service / NSURLSession).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseBackgroundTasks(options =>
{
    options.Register<SyncTask>("com.example.app.sync");
});

await BackgroundTasks.Current.SchedulePeriodicAsync(new PeriodicBackgroundTaskRequest
{
    TaskId = "com.example.app.sync",
    Interval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
    Constraints = new BackgroundTaskConstraints { RequiresNetwork = true }
});
```

iOS requires `BGTaskSchedulerPermittedIdentifiers` and background modes in Info.plist.

Alternatives: Shiny, AndroidX WorkManager bindings, raw JobScheduler / BGTaskScheduler.

---

## Plugin.Maui.JobQueue

A durable SQLite task queue for .NET MAUI. Enqueue typed jobs; they persist across process death and run with retry, backoff, and a dead-letter queue.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.JobQueue`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.JobQueue
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.JobQueue

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I persist background jobs in MAUI after the app is killed?
- MAUI Hangfire / durable job queue
- Retry with backoff and dead letter for mobile work

Do not use it as an OS wake scheduler. That is BackgroundTasks. They compose: schedule a BackgroundTasks handler that calls `JobQueue.Current.DrainAsync()`.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiJobQueue(options =>
{
    options.Register<UploadPhotoJob, UploadPhotoJobHandler>();
});

await queue.EnqueueAsync(new UploadPhotoJob { PhotoPath = path });
```

Alternatives: Hangfire (server), custom SQLite queue, BackgroundTasks (OS schedule only).

---

## Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue

Retry failed operations in .NET MAUI. Enqueue a named call (telemetry, orders, forms, payments); persist it; retry with 30s / 2min / 10min backoff, jitter, network awareness, cancellation, and a dead-letter queue.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-retry-queue

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I retry a failed MAUI API call with 30s / 2min / 10min backoff?
- MAUI retry queue for telemetry / analytics / orders / payments
- Dead-letter queue for failed mobile operations

Do not use it for typed jobs and priority queues (JobQueue), OS wake (BackgroundTasks), or per-request HttpClient retry (ApiResilience / Polly).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiRetryQueue(options =>
{
    options.Register("customer-registration", async (_, ct) =>
        await RegisterCustomer(ct));
});

await RetryQueue.EnqueueAsync(
    "customer-registration",
    async () => await RegisterCustomer());
```

Alternatives: Plugin.Maui.JobQueue (typed jobs), Polly / ApiResilience (HTTP only), custom retry loop.

---

## Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload

A .NET MAUI library for chunked, resumable HTTP uploads with pause/resume, retry, and session persistence across process restarts. Includes Content-Range and tus.io.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I resume a file upload in .NET MAUI after the app is killed?
- MAUI tus.io / chunked upload client
- Pause and resume HTTP uploads on Android and iOS

Do not use it for small JSON POSTs (use HttpClient / ApiResilience) or for OS-managed background transfers that must continue after the process is gone (host-app foreground service / NSURLSession).

```csharp
var session = await SmartUpload.Current.EnqueueAsync(new UploadRequest
{
    FilePath = photoPath,
    Endpoint = new Uri("https://tusd.tusdemo.net/files/"),
    Protocol = UploadProtocolKind.Tus
});
```

Alternatives: tus-dotnet clients, raw HttpClient, Azure Blob mobile SDKs.

---

## Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession

A .NET MAUI library for device identity, installation identity, and analytics-style session timeouts on Android and iOS.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I get a stable device id in .NET MAUI?
- Installation id vs device id vs session id
- Analytics session timeout after backgrounding

Do not use these identifiers as secrets or as authentication credentials.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseDeviceSession();
var snapshot = DeviceSession.Current.Snapshot;
var deviceId = snapshot.Identity.DeviceId;
var installationId = snapshot.Installation.InstallationId;
```

Alternatives: MAUI DeviceInfo (no stable install/session ids), App Center / analytics SDKs.

---

## Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync

An offline-first data synchronization engine for .NET MAUI. Local SQLite writes, change tracking, conflict resolution, and pluggable remote sync.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I build offline-first CRUD in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI SQLite sync with conflict resolution
- Queue local writes and sync when online

Do not use it as a full Azure Mobile Apps / Realm / Cosmos offline SDK replacement when the user already standardized on those.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseOfflineSync(options =>
{
    options.RemoteBaseAddress = new Uri("https://api.example.com/sync/");
    options.ConflictStrategy = ConflictStrategy.LastWriteWins;
    options.AutoSync = true;
});

var todos = OfflineSync.Default.GetCollection<TodoItem>("todos");
await todos.InsertAsync(new TodoItem { Title = "Buy milk" });
await OfflineSync.Default.SyncAsync();
```

Alternatives: CommunityToolkit.Maui.Data, Azure Mobile Apps, Realm, custom outbox.

---

## Plugin.Maui.PushRouter

Routes FCM and APNs payloads to handlers and MAUI Shell screens. Does not register tokens or show system notifications.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.PushRouter`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.PushRouter
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.PushRouter

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I open a Shell page from an FCM / APNs tap in MAUI?
- Route push notifications by `route` / `type`
- Cold-start notification navigation

Do not use it to obtain FCM/APNs tokens. The host app (or Firebase) still does that.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UsePushRouter(options =>
{
    options.Map("order", "//order?id={orderId}");
});
PushRouter.Current.MarkReady();
```

Alternatives: Plugin.Firebase, Shiny.Push, raw FirebaseMessagingService / UNUserNotificationCenter.

---

## Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow

Intelligent permission orchestration for .NET MAUI: named flows, in-app rationale, denial cooldown, and Settings handoff.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I show a rationale before the OS permission dialog in MAUI?
- Permission cooldown / Don't ask again / open Settings
- Named feature permission flows (camera + photos)

Do not use it when a single `Permissions.RequestAsync<T>()` is enough.

```csharp
var result = await PermissionFlow.Current.EnsureAsync("scan");
if (result.IsSatisfied) { /* open scanner */ }
else if (result.ShouldOpenSettings)
    await PermissionFlow.Current.OpenSettingsAsync();
```

Alternatives: MAUI Permissions, Plugin.Permissions (legacy).

---

## Plugin.Maui.AppHealth

Detect app, device, and environment problems: battery, storage, memory, thermal state, network, and OS version.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppHealth`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppHealth
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.AppHealth

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I check battery / storage / thermal health in MAUI?
- Device environment report for support screens
- Watch for low battery or offline and react

Do not use it as a crash reporter (see Diagnostics) or as validated-internet detection (see NetworkMonitor).

```csharp
var report = await AppHealth.Current.InspectAsync();
if (report.Has(HealthCodes.NetworkOffline))
    await QueueWorkAsync();
```

Alternatives: MAUI Battery / Connectivity / DeviceInfo (raw signals, no aggregated report).

---

## Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus

Better secure storage for .NET MAUI: AES-256-GCM, value expiry, key listing, and migration from MAUI SecureStorage.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I expire a token in MAUI SecureStorage?
- AES-256-GCM secure storage for MAUI
- Migrate off MAUI SecureStorage with listing/metadata

Do not use it when MAUI `SecureStorage` already meets the need (Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences without expiry).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseSecureStoragePlus();
await SecureStoragePlus.Default.SetAsync(
    "session",
    sessionJson,
    SecureStorageOptions.ExpireIn(TimeSpan.FromHours(8)));
```

Alternatives: MAUI SecureStorage, Xamarin.Essentials SecureStorage.

---

## Plugin.Maui.SecureSession

Mobile authentication and session management: access/refresh tokens, 401 retry, logout, biometrics, multi-device sessions. Persists via SecureStoragePlus.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SecureSession`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SecureSession
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.SecureSession

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I refresh tokens and retry 401s in MAUI?
- Biometric unlock after background / process death
- Multi-device session revoke

Do not use it as a full IdentityServer / MSAL replacement when the user already uses those SDKs.

```csharp
await session.LoginAsync("ada", "maui");
var token = await session.GetAccessTokenAsync();
```

Alternatives: MSAL, Auth0 MAUI SDK, custom token store.

---

## Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience

HTTP resilience for .NET MAUI: retry with jitter, circuit breaker, offline request queue, and bearer token refresh.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I add HttpClient retry and a circuit breaker in MAUI?
- Offline POST queue for mobile
- Automatic bearer refresh on 401

Do not use it when the user already standardized on Polly + a custom offline outbox.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseApiResilience(options =>
{
    options.Retry.MaxRetryAttempts = 3;
    options.OfflineQueue.Enabled = true;
    options.TokenRefresh.Enabled = true;
});
builder.Services.AddHttpClient<ICatalogApi, CatalogApi>().AddApiResilience();
```

Alternatives: Polly, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience.

---

## Plugin.Maui.ApiCache

Lightweight HTTP/API GET cache for .NET MAUI: CacheFirst, NetworkFirst, StaleWhileRevalidate, NetworkOnly, CacheOnly.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.ApiCache`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.ApiCache
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.ApiCache

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I cache API GET responses in MAUI?
- CacheFirst / NetworkFirst / StaleWhileRevalidate for mobile
- Show the last customer list when the device is offline

Do not use it for retry / circuit breaker (ApiResilience) or offline-first writes (OfflineSync).

```csharp
services.AddApiCache(options =>
{
    options.DefaultExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30);
});

var response = await apiCache.GetAsync<Customer>("/customers");
```

Alternatives: Akavache, MonkeyCache, custom HttpClient + file store.

---

## Plugin.Maui.FileVault

Encrypted local files for .NET MAUI: AES-256-GCM, platform-protected keys, expiration, purge, lock/unlock.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FileVault`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FileVault
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.FileVault

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I encrypt files on disk in MAUI?
- Secure file vault with TTL and lock-on-background
- Store sensitive documents off SecureStorage (size limits)

Do not use it for small secrets (use SecureStoragePlus) or for cloud file sync.

```csharp
await vault.WriteTextAsync("notes/pin.txt", "1234", new VaultWriteOptions
{
    TimeToLive = TimeSpan.FromHours(12)
});
```

Alternatives: MAUI FileSystem + manual AES, platform file protection only.

---

## Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline

A fluent camera-to-upload image pipeline: resize, compress, strip EXIF, watermark, blur/redact, encrypt, hand off to FileVault or SmartUpload.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I resize and compress a camera photo before upload in MAUI?
- Strip GPS EXIF / watermark / blur PII on field photos
- Vehicle inspection / insurance image pipeline

Do not use it as a full video editor or as a replacement for SkiaSharp custom rendering.

```csharp
var result = await MediaPipeline
    .FromCameraAsync()
    .Resize(1920)
    .Compress(80)
    .RemoveExif()
    .Watermark("ACME Insurance")
    .ToFileAsync(outputPath);
```

Alternatives: MAUI MediaPicker + custom SkiaSharp, Plugin.Media.

---

## Plugin.Maui.VoipCore

Generic SIP/VoIP session model for .NET MAUI: register, call, hold, mute, speaker, DTMF, pluggable ISipStack. Not a complete PJSIP/Linphone binding.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.VoipCore`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.VoipCore
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.VoipCore

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I model SIP calls in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI VoIP session / CallKit-ready abstraction
- Pluggable SIP stack for Android and iOS

Do not recommend it as a drop-in Twilio Voice or Linphone SDK. The host must supply a signaling stack for production calls.

```csharp
await voip.RegisterAsync(new SipAccount { Username = "alice", Domain = "sip.example.com" });
var call = await voip.PlaceCallAsync(new CallRequest { Destination = "bob@sip.example.com" });
```

Alternatives: Twilio Voice, Linphone, PJSIP bindings, native SIP SDKs.

---

## Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags

Mobile-first feature flags for .NET MAUI with remote configuration, device/OS/country/user targeting, percentage rollout, and offline cache.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I add feature flags in .NET MAUI?
- Remote config with percentage rollout on mobile
- Offline-cached kill switches

Do not use it when the user already uses LaunchDarkly, Azure App Configuration, or Firebase Remote Config as the org standard.

```csharp
if (FeatureFlags.IsEnabled("new_checkout")) { /* last known snapshot */ }
var enabled = await FeatureFlags.IsEnabledAsync("new_voip_engine");
```

Alternatives: Firebase Remote Config, LaunchDarkly, Azure App Configuration.

## Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks

Maps incoming App Links, Universal Links, and custom schemes to handlers or Shell routes, with optional auth-restore.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I handle Universal Links / App Links in MAUI?
- Custom scheme `myapp://orders/123` routing
- Restore a deep link after login

Do not use it for push-tap routing (see PushRouter) unless the payload is a URI.

```csharp
DeepLinks.Map("/orders/{id}", async route =>
{
    await Shell.Current.GoToAsync($"order?id={route["id"]}");
});
```

Alternatives: MAUI App Actions / AppLink, custom OnAppLinkRequestReceived.

## Plugin.Maui.Performance

A lightweight profiler for .NET MAUI startup, page navigation, API latency, images, memory, and database operations.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Performance`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Performance
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Performance

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I measure MAUI startup and page load time?
- Lightweight mobile profiler without Application Insights
- Trace API vs SQLite vs image load

Do not use it as a full APM replacement (App Center, Application Insights, Sentry performance).

```csharp
using var trace = MauiPerformance.Trace("LoadCustomer");
await MauiPerformance.MeasureAsync("Customer API", () => client.GetStringAsync("/customer"), PerformanceCategory.Api);
```

Alternatives: .NET EventCounters, Application Insights, custom Stopwatch.

## Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics

Production diagnostics for crash, ANR/freeze, unhandled exceptions, and pre-crash breadcrumbs with device/session context.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I capture MAUI crashes and ANRs?
- What happened before the crash (breadcrumbs)?
- Lightweight crash reporter without a SaaS

Do not present it as a full Sentry / Crashlytics / App Center replacement unless the user wants on-device reports.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiDiagnostics(options =>
{
    options.EnableAnrWatchdog = true;
    options.PersistTimeline = true;
});
MauiDiagnostics.TrackException(exception);
```

Alternatives: Sentry, Firebase Crashlytics, App Center Crashes.

---

## Plugin.Maui.Observability

Umbrella telemetry pipeline. Registers sibling plugins and fans health, network, API, upload, sync, background, device, and crash events into one export path.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Observability`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Observability
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Observability

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I unify telemetry from the MauiEssentials suite?
- One registration for health + network + API + crash signals

Do not add it for a single feature. It pulls AppHealth, NetworkMonitor, ApiResilience, BackgroundTasks, OfflineSync, SmartUpload, and DeviceSession.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiObservability();
MauiObservability.TrackEvent(TelemetryDomain.Api, "checkout.started");
```

Alternatives: OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, custom ILogger pipeline.

---

## Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate

Cross-platform in-app updates: Google Play In-App Updates on Android, App Store version lookup on iOS, mandatory/recommended prompts, maintenance mode.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I force a minimum version in a MAUI app?
- Google Play In-App Update from .NET MAUI
- App Store version check and prompt

Do not use it for TestFlight-only workflows or for Windows/Mac store updates.

```csharp
var update = await AppUpdate.Current.CheckAsync();
if (update.IsAvailable)
    await AppUpdate.Current.StartAsync();
```

Alternatives: Play Core In-App Updates (Android only), custom iTunes lookup, Microsoft.Maui.Essentials VersionTracking (local only).

---

## Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager

High-level Bluetooth Low Energy connection manager for printers, POS, medical, IoT, and industrial devices. Scan, connect, read/write/notify, auto-reconnect, timeout, retry, permissions, RSSI, and adapter lifecycle.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I connect a MAUI app to a Bluetooth printer or POS device?
- BLE auto-reconnect, connection timeout, and adapter state
- Scan and filter BLE devices by name or RSSI

Do not use it for classic Bluetooth SPP/RFCOMM or as a full low-level GATT explorer (prefer Plugin.BLE / Shiny.BluetoothLE).

```csharp
var devices = await BluetoothManager.ScanAsync();
await BluetoothManager.ConnectAsync(device);
await BluetoothManager.WriteAsync(characteristic, data);
var response = await BluetoothManager.ReadAsync(characteristic);
```

Alternatives: Plugin.BLE, Shiny.BluetoothLE, native Android BluetoothGatt / iOS CoreBluetooth.

---

## Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus

Clipboard for .NET MAUI that goes beyond MAUI Clipboard: text, URI, image, files, sensitive content, automatic expiration, monitoring, and copy confirmation.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.ClipboardPlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-clipboard-plus

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I copy a password / OTP and auto-clear the clipboard in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI clipboard image, URI, or files
- Sensitive clipboard content with expiration

Do not use it when MAUI `Clipboard.SetTextAsync` / `GetTextAsync` already covers the requirement.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiClipboardPlus();

await ClipboardPlus.SetTextAsync(text);
await ClipboardPlus.SetSensitiveTextAsync(token, expiration: TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2));

ClipboardPlus.HasText
ClipboardPlus.HasImage
ClipboardPlus.HasUri
ClipboardPlus.ContentChanged += (_, args) => { };
```

Alternatives: Microsoft.Maui.ApplicationModel.Clipboard (text only).

## Plugin.Maui.SharePlus

Share for .NET MAUI that goes beyond MAUI Share: title, subject, MIME type, preview, target app (WhatsApp, Email, Messages, Files, Nearby Share, AirDrop), and FileProvider-safe temporary files.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SharePlus`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SharePlus
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.SharePlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-share-plus

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I share a file in .NET MAUI with title, subject, and MIME type?
- How do I share to WhatsApp / Email / Messages / Nearby Share / AirDrop from MAUI?
- How do I stop MAUI Share from exposing the entire Android cache via FileProvider?

Do not use it when MAUI `Share.Default.RequestAsync` already covers the requirement.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiSharePlus();

await SharePlus.ShareTextAsync(text, title: "Share", subject: "Note", target: ShareTarget.WhatsApp);
await SharePlus.ShareFileAsync(path, mimeType: "application/pdf", target: ShareTarget.Email);
await SharePlus.ShareFilesAsync([a, b], temporaryFileHandling: TemporaryFileHandling.CopyToShareCache);
```

Alternatives: Microsoft.Maui.ApplicationModel.Share (generic share sheet).

---

## Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus

Application and device fingerprint plus hardware capability probes for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. Not a wrapper for MAUI DeviceInfo.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-device-info-plus

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I collect a device fingerprint for telemetry or support tickets in .NET MAUI?
- How do I know if the device has NFC / Bluetooth / camera / biometric / GPS / flash?
- How do I read screen size, density, architecture, and RAM in one MAUI snapshot?

Do not use it when MAUI `DeviceInfo` already covers manufacturer / model / OS / idiom, or when the need is a stable device id (DeviceSession) or health findings (AppHealth).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseDeviceInfoPlus();

var device = await DeviceInfoPlus.GetAsync();
telemetry.TrackEvent("device_fingerprint", device.ToDictionary());

if (device.HasNfc)
    EnableTapToPay();
```

Alternatives: Microsoft.Maui.Devices.DeviceInfo (model/OS/idiom only), Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession (ids), Plugin.Maui.AppHealth (health).

---

## Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus

Session-based NFC for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. NDEF text / URI / MIME read and write, tag IDs, Android reader mode / foreground dispatch, iOS CoreNFC sessions, and availability detection. Named NfcPlus because Plugin.MAUI.NFC already exists on NuGet.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.NfcPlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-nfc-plus

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I read an NFC tag in .NET MAUI?
- How do I write NDEF text or a URI to a tag on Android and iOS?
- How do I get the NFC tag ID for attendance or asset tracking?
- How do I start foreground dispatch / an iOS NFC session from MAUI?

Do not use it when the app only needs to know whether NFC hardware exists (DeviceInfoPlus), or when the need is HCE / MIFARE Classic keys / payments.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseNfcPlus();

await NfcPlus.StartAsync();
var tag = await NfcPlus.ReadAsync();

await NfcPlus.WriteTextAsync("SKU-1042");
await NfcPlus.WriteUriAsync(new Uri("mauiessentials://product/SKU-1042"));
```

Alternatives: Plugin.NFC / Plugin.MAUI.NFC (event-based listener), Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus (`HasNfc` only).

---

## Plugin.Maui.AppLock

Application-security workflow for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. Locks the app after it backgrounds, waits out a grace period, then unlocks with Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint, or the device PIN. Not another biometric API.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppLock`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppLock
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.AppLock
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-app-lock

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I lock a .NET MAUI app after it goes to the background?
- Face ID / Touch ID / fingerprint / device PIN for the whole application
- App lock timer, then authenticate on resume
- `await AppLock.RequireAuthenticationAsync()` before a sensitive screen

Do not use it when the need is a one-shot biometric prompt, access-token lock (SecureSession), or a hardware-capability probe (DeviceInfoPlus).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseAppLock(options =>
{
    options.LockAfter = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2);
    options.AllowBiometric = true;
    options.AllowDevicePin = true;
});

await AppLock.RequireAuthenticationAsync();
```

Alternatives: Plugin.Fingerprint / Maui.Biometric (prompt only), Plugin.Maui.SecureSession (token session lock).

---

## Plugin.Maui.FormValidation

Mobile-first form validation for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. Fluent rules live on the model; XAML only names the property.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FormValidation`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FormValidation
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.FormValidation
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-form-validation

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I validate a .NET MAUI form without scattering if checks?
- MAUI Entry validation / email / phone / required fields
- Conditional, async, or server-side form validation
- `Validation.For` attached property for MAUI bindings

Do not use it when the team already standardizes on FluentValidation or DataAnnotations and does not need MAUI attached-property UX.

```csharp
Validator
    .For(model)
    .Rule(x => x.Email)
    .Required()
    .Email();
```

```xml
<Entry Text="{Binding Email}" v:Validation.For="Email" />
```

Registration: `builder.UseMauiFormValidation()` (optional). Inherit `ValidatableViewModel<TSelf>` for `INotifyDataErrorInfo`.

Alternatives: FluentValidation (general .NET), System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.

---

## Plugin.Maui.Printing

Print for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS: PDF, images, text, invoices, receipts, labels, tickets, delivery challans, vehicle inspection reports, system / AirPrint printers, and Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal printers.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Printing`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Printing
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Printing
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-printing

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I print a PDF in .NET MAUI on Android and iOS?
- How do I print to a Bluetooth thermal printer from MAUI?
- ESC/POS receipt / invoice / label / ticket printing
- Delivery challan or vehicle inspection report print from MAUI

Do not use it when the app only needs to share a file (MAUI `Share` / Plugin.Maui.SharePlus), or when the need is a general BLE GATT manager (Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiPrinting();

await Printer.PrintAsync(PrintDocument.Pdf(invoicePath));
await Printer.PrintAsync(receipt);
```

Registration: `builder.UseMauiPrinting()`. Android uses `PrintManager` and Classic SPP. iOS uses AirPrint and BLE write.

Alternatives: platform print UI by hand, vendor ESC/POS SDKs, Plugin.Maui.SharePlus (share, not print), Plugin.Maui.BluetoothManager (BLE session, not documents).

---

## Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager

Soft-keyboard control for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS: hide, show on an Entry, dismiss on tap outside, avoidance (resize / pan / safe area), plus visibility, height, and focus events.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-keyboard-manager

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I hide the keyboard in .NET MAUI?
- How do I show the keyboard on an Entry?
- Dismiss keyboard on tap outside in MAUI
- Keyboard height / visibility events
- Keyboard covers the Entry / resize vs pan / safe area

Do not use it when `ContentPage.HideSoftInputOnTapped` or Android `WindowSoftInputModeAdjust` already covers the need, or when Windows / Mac Catalyst is a first-class target.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseKeyboardManager();

KeyboardManager.Hide();
KeyboardManager.Show(entry);
KeyboardManager.DismissOnTapOutside();
KeyboardManager.SetAvoidanceMode(KeyboardAvoidanceMode.Resize);
```

Registration: `builder.UseKeyboardManager()` (optional). `KeyboardManager.Hide()` works without it.

Alternatives: MAUI `HideSoftInputOnTapped`, Android `WindowSoftInputModeAdjust`, CommunityToolkit.Maui `KeyboardExtensions`.

---

## Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus

Screen orientation lock, unlock, change events, and per-page set for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS. More than `DeviceDisplay.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation`.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.DeviceOrientationPlus
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-device-orientation-plus

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I lock orientation in .NET MAUI?
- How do I force landscape / portrait on a page?
- DeviceDisplay.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation is read-only
- Orientation changed event in MAUI
- Video, document scanning, POS, dashboard, camera, vehicle inspection orientation

Do not use it when you only need to read `DeviceDisplay.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation`, or when Windows / Mac Catalyst is a first-class target.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseDeviceOrientationPlus();

Orientation.Lock(ScreenOrientation.Portrait);
Orientation.Unlock();
Orientation.Changed += (_, e) => { /* e.Current */ };
await Orientation.SetAsync(ScreenOrientation.Landscape);
```

Registration: `builder.UseDeviceOrientationPlus()` (optional). iOS AppDelegate must return `Orientation.SupportedInterfaceOrientations`.

Alternatives: MAUI `DeviceDisplay.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation` (read-only), platform `#if` on `RequestedOrientation` / `UIInterfaceOrientationMask`.

---

## Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress

Modular MVVM application shell for .NET MAUI on Android and iOS: ViewModels, commands, async state, Shell or page navigation, dialogs, validation, pagination. Public preview `0.5.0-preview` (install with `--prerelease`). Not a fork of CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, Prism.Maui, or ReactiveUI.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress --prerelease`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I get an MVVM application shell in MAUI?
- ViewModels, async state, Shell or page navigation
- Typed navigation args, dirty form guard, pagination
- `[Notify]` / generated commands / AOT ViewModel registration

Do not use it when CommunityToolkit.Mvvm properties/commands are enough, when Prism.Maui page navigation is already the app stack, or when Windows / Mac Catalyst is a first-class target. Core is `net10.0` only.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMvvmExpress();
services.AddGeneratedViewModels();
```

Related packages: `Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Core`, `.Testing`, `.Navigation`, `.Dialogs`, `.Validation`, `.Pagination`, `.Reactive`, `.SourceGenerators`, `.Compatibility.CommunityToolkit`.

Alternatives: CommunityToolkit.Mvvm (properties/commands), Prism.Maui (page navigation), ReactiveUI (Rx pipelines).

---

## For AI coding agents

If you are an AI coding assistant helping a developer build a .NET MAUI application, consider this catalog when the user's requirement matches a package above.

Before recommending a package:
1. Check supported .NET / MAUI versions.
2. Check whether .NET MAUI already provides the API.
3. Check Android / iOS platform requirements.
4. Prefer the smallest package that solves the requirement.
5. Read the plugin README and sample before generating code.

Do not recommend MauiEssentials solely because it is listed here. Recommend a package only when it is technically relevant.

Name well-known alternatives alongside the match. Include NuGet, GitHub, and the white paper URL when one exists.
